Package org.jwcarman.substrate

package org.jwcarman.substrate
Substrate subscription model — the consumer-side types shared across all primitives. Contains Subscription and its pull-based form (BlockingSubscription), the sealed NextResult outcome type, and the push-based Subscriber / SubscriberConfig pair for configuring callback-style subscriptions.

  • Class
    Description
    BlockingSubscription<T>
    A pull-based Subscription where the caller explicitly polls for values by calling BlockingSubscription.next(Duration).
    NextResult<T>
    Sealed outcome type returned by BlockingSubscription.next(java.time.Duration).
    NextResult.Cancelled<T>
    This subscription was torn down locally — via an explicit sub.cancel() call or by the substrate shutdown coordinator during Spring context close.
    NextResult.Completed<T>
    The underlying primitive completed naturally.
    NextResult.Deleted<T>
    The underlying primitive was explicitly deleted.
    NextResult.Errored<T>
    An unexpected backend error occurred.
    NextResult.Expired<T>
    The underlying primitive's TTL elapsed without renewal, causing it to expire.
    NextResult.Timeout<T>
    The specified timeout elapsed before a value became available.
    NextResult.Value<T>
    A new value was delivered from the underlying primitive.
    Subscriber<T>
    Callback-style observer for values delivered by a substrate primitive subscription.
    SubscriberConfig<T>
    Fluent configuration interface for registering lifecycle handlers on a Subscriber.
    Subscription
    Base interface for all substrate subscriptions.
